No test suite in this repo. All 12 application files (repos/services/admins across accounts, billing, orders, catalog, support, analytics) are migrated to `db.execute({ sql, params })` — verified with a grep, only `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` still calls `db.query`.

I left that one alone on purpose: it's a vendored copy of a third-party package, and the file itself says local edits get silently wiped on every upgrade. Migrating it would just get reverted — that one needs a real fix upstream (or a wrapper) rather than a direct edit here. Flagging it to you rather than silently skipping it.
